caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bucket constructed from vertical wooden planks bound together by two metal bands, one near the top and one near the bottom, both depicted in a reddish-brown color. The wood shows signs of wear and aging, with visible grain, cracks, and knots; the coloring of the wood ranges from pale tan to medium brown. A dark brown, curved metal handle is attached to either side of the bucket with metal loops, and the handle arches above the bucket in an irregular shape. The bucket interior and exterior are both visible, with the interior also showing aged wood and two holes, one circular and one diamond-shaped, in the upper planks. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Miner's Ore Bucket
